summary: Verified bug fix: 'Contrôle du niveau d'huile des compresseurs' preventive maintenance is now present and selectable in the Nouvelle intervention preventive dropdown for both BAUER 01 and BAUER 02.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console) — non-blocking.
Recharts container width/height(-1) console warnings on Dashboard — cosmetic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interventions modal preventive dropdown uses cmdk; use [cmdk-input] and [cmdk-item] selectors. Data reactivation fix verified successful. 27 planifiee/en_cours preventive WOs available including 7 huile-related entries (BAUER 01, BAUER 02 for 'Contrôle du niveau d'huile', plus vidange and inspection variants). Selecting a compressor-linked maintenance shows 'Compteur horaire compresseur' field (Valeur actuelle: 7,002 h).
rca of the issue: During historical import, past preventive work orders were marked 'terminee' without generating a next active occurrence, so recurring maintenances with no future planifiee/en_cours record disappeared from the Interventions.jsx preventiveWorkOrders filter (line 81-83). Fix: reactivated most recent occurrence (statut='planifiee') per preventive template lacking active WO. Verified via UI: huile entries now visible.
